name: scene_test
description: Test a group/scene's physical wiring: sends a real group-off to the group/scene (its member devices WILL turn off) and reports which members responded. Use when the customer complains a group/scene isn't working, only some of its devices respond, or some respond intermittently. Because it actually switches the members off, only after the customer has explicitly agreed -- never speculatively. Returns 'summary': one {name, address, status: success|failure} entry per member; 'note': present only if at least one member failed; 'details': raw protocol trace, evidence only -- not a statement about the group/scene's configured on/off behavior. INSTEON-only for now.

group_address.description: The group/scene's real id, exactly as shown in DEVICE DATABASE -- never guessed.
